summary: Some employers pay severance as continuing salary, even if the person finds new work, so they do not delay the search.
realLife: HR guidance describes packages with severance pay, outplacement, continued health benefits and priority for internal openings, and suggests salary continuation continuing even after a new job starts.
sources: SHRM, Layoffs require communication, compassion, compliance: https://www.shrm.org/mena/topics-tools/news/talent-acquisition/layoffs-require-communication-compassion-compliance
inGame: needs: severance payments; the jobs module has pay on the job record but no severance flow. Scene: needs a producer for layoff-terms.

turns.summary: The employer pays the severance in one lump sum, and the person gets it at once.
pulledBy: a pay figure the employer can afford
turns.writesBack: Money lands in the person's accounts, and the mood eases.

turns.summary: Salary continues but stops the day the person starts new work.
pulledBy: the job record of the person
turns.writesBack: The person may delay the search or hurry it, and the journal notes the terms.

turns.summary: The employer offers nothing beyond the last paycheck.
pulledBy: a short tenure on the job record
turns.writesBack: Money is tight, the mood turns bitter, and the tie to the employer cools.
